name: eng2
description: Database engine facade over `kotobase-peer` internals. Applications use the provider-neutral **`kotobase.datomic.client`** namespace as a drop-in for published `datomic.client.api` (same arg-maps and return shapes), or the lower-level `kotobase.datomic` grammar facade. Neither depends on the historical “peer” naming, XRPC, or a storage provider SDK.
